population.filter: view_type == FULL_FIELD AND sample_id IN clean-v3 TRAIN manifest

mapping.method: per-GT-component: original centroid -> (cx*scale+left)/4,(cy*scale+top)/4 -> 128-space label area (EXACT H3 runtime path; NO relabeling of combined downsampled mask)
mapping.scale: min(512/w,512/h); aspect-preserving NEAREST resize + centre pad to 512
mapping.note: Component identity preserved by (sample_id, component_id). 128-space area is the label area at the component's mapped centroid, matching kub_localizer_dataset.py.

A_ref_definition: p75 of per-component 128-space areas over canonical clean-v3 TRAIN FULL_FIELD
zero_area_handling: Deterministic frozen rule: area_128 == 0 -> sigma = sigma_min (0.35). The Gaussian is still drawn at the centroid; a zero-area component is treated as the smallest possible object (sharpest peak). No VAL/TEST influence.

h3_aref_code_exact.json.method: relabeled 128-space components (n=1149) -- MERGES components, cardinality wrong -> superseded

h3_code_exact_sigma_distribution.json.method: relabeled direct 128-space (n=1078) -- relabeling, cardinality wrong -> superseded

superseded_calibrations.reason_for_difference: Both prior values relabeled the combined downsampled mask, which merges neighbouring components and drops tinies, changing component cardinality and inflating/deflating areas. The authoritative path preserves (sample_id,component_id) and reads the 128-area at each centroid, matching the runtime.
